description_policy.public_copy: Outcome-focused, recruiter-ready, and limited to capabilities present in the reviewed public source.
description_policy.stable_identity: Repository slugs, package names, dependency-sensitive paths, checksummed artifacts, and historical release names remain unchanged.
description_policy.version_language: Version numbers appear in public descriptions only when needed to explain a verified source or checksum-gated successor.
description_policy.live_metadata_enforcement: Source-controlled descriptions are canonical; live GitHub About-field drift is reported for manual correction.

repositories.name: botops-manager
repositories.expected_description: Local Windows operations console that verifies launchers and process ownership, tracks health evidence, and creates bounded redacted support exports.
repositories.profile_summary: Verifies launchers and process ownership before control, consolidates health evidence, and creates bounded redacted support exports for independent Windows automation.

repositories.name: digital-asset-governance-case-study
repositories.expected_description: Read-only catalog audit that turns provenance gaps, confidence signals, and duplicate candidates into a prioritized review queue with clear next steps.
repositories.profile_summary: Turns schema health, provenance coverage, confidence signals, and duplicate candidates into a prioritized stewardship queue with clear reasons and next steps using synthetic data.

repositories.name: media-tagger-bot
repositories.expected_description: Local-first media organizer using evidence-based matching, dry-run review, recorded changes, result verification, and rollback manifests.
repositories.profile_summary: Uses evidence-based matching, complete-scan gates, dry-run review, recorded changes, result verification, verified renames, and rollback manifests. Uncertain or preservation-sensitive files remain visible for review instead of being forced into a match.

repositories.name: chicago-food-inspections-analysis
repositories.expected_description: Reproducible analysis of 13,333 Chicago inspection records that separates outcome from facility risk and documents interpretive limits.
repositories.profile_summary: Reproducibly analyzes 13,333 public inspection records, separates outcome from facility risk, and surfaces decision-relevant follow-up questions without overstating the data.

repositories.name: avalon-q-supervisor
repositories.expected_description: Local-first Avalon Q supervisor with clear health states, dry-run-first recovery, durable restart limits, and privacy-conscious audit evidence.
repositories.profile_summary: Turns local device telemetry into clear health states, requires two independent approvals for recovery, enforces durable restart limits, and records privacy-conscious decision evidence.

repositories.name: automation-reliability-case-studies
repositories.expected_description: Three reliability studies on confirming uncertain outcomes, limiting recovery attempts, and stopping safely when evidence is incomplete.
repositories.profile_summary: Three documented studies show how outcome checks, identity-bound supervision, integrity verification, limited recovery, and explicit stop conditions contain risk across uncertain system boundaries.

repositories.name: beta-earth
repositories.expected_description: Browser RPG with layered progression, portable local launchers, resilient saves, and verified v0.4.11 source; v0.5.0 awaits exact-source promotion.
repositories.profile_summary: A working browser RPG with portable local launchers, resilient saves, bounded validation, and verified public source at v0.4.11. The newer verified v0.5.0 final remains visible behind an exact-source checksum gate instead of being falsely represented by the older tree.

repositories.name: safe-video-downloader
repositories.expected_description: Authorized-media downloader with public-network checks, duplicate controls, isolated workers, a no-progress watchdog, resumable partials, and output verification.
repositories.profile_summary: Retrieves authorized media through shared desktop and command-line planning, public-network checks, duplicate controls, isolated workers, a five-second no-progress watchdog, resumable partials, and verified output.

repositories.name: mp3-downloader
repositories.expected_description: Authorized audio-only downloader with metadata preflight, bounded recovery, duplicate reconciliation, validated MP3 output, and redacted support exports.
repositories.profile_summary: Turns one authorized URL into a validated MP3 through metadata preflight, bounded recovery, SHA-256 and SQLite duplicate reconciliation, visible output, and tightly redacted support exports.

repositories.name: image-downloader
repositories.expected_description: Permissioned image collection with bounded discovery, five-second transfer budgets, content validation, resumable state, duplicate controls, and atomic writes.
repositories.profile_summary: Collects permitted images with bounded discovery, five-second per-image network budgets, streamed content validation, resumable state, layered duplicate controls, and atomic finalization.

repositories.name: large-text-chunker
repositories.expected_description: Local text chunking with readable boundaries, context overlap, SHA-256 manifests, and exact reconstruction verification; v1.10.0 remains checksum-gated.
repositories.profile_summary: Splits local documents at readable boundaries, preserves configurable context, records SHA-256 integrity metadata, and verifies exact reconstruction. Public source remains v1.0.0 while the recorded v1.10.0 final awaits its exact checksum-matched archive.

repositories.name: net-loss-doctor
repositories.expected_description: Read-only Windows network diagnostics that correlate gateway, DNS, latency, events, and optional traces into bounded redacted evidence.
repositories.profile_summary: Correlates gateway, route, DNS, TCP, latency, Windows event, and optional trace evidence into time-bounded, redacted support packages without changing network configuration.

repositories.name: lan-router-comms
repositories.expected_description: Cloud-free authenticated text and resumable file exchange between trusted Windows PCs, with durable queues, replay protection, and verified delivery.
repositories.profile_summary: Provides cloud-free authenticated text and resumable file exchange between trusted Windows PCs using durable queues, replay protection, bounded sessions, and verified delivery receipts.

repositories.name: windows-health-audit
repositories.expected_description: Read-only, non-elevated Windows health baseline with failure-isolated collectors, privacy-preserving output, and transparent review thresholds.
repositories.profile_summary: Creates a read-only, non-elevated Windows health baseline with failure-isolated collectors, privacy-preserving normalization, transparent review thresholds, and no network or system changes.

repositories.name: inbox-from-hell
repositories.expected_description: Five-shift workplace-horror browser game with branching support decisions, layered progression, accessible controls, resilient saves, and campaign tests.
repositories.profile_summary: A five-shift workplace-horror browser game with 29 branching support cases, layered office and career progression, accessible controls, resilient local saves, and automated full-campaign acceptance testing.

repositories.name: kalshi-10x1c-public
repositories.expected_description: Checksum-controlled educational prediction-market entry planner with explicit activation, duplicate-action prevention, bounded execution, and safe stopping rules.
repositories.profile_summary: A checksum-controlled educational entry planner demonstrating explicit activation, authenticated API use, duplicate-action prevention, bounded execution, and safe stopping rules.

repositories.name: kalshi-15m-sell-bot-public-preview
repositories.expected_description: Dry-run-only prediction-market exit preview with live writes blocked, bounded polling, state checks, and release verification.
repositories.profile_summary: A checksum-consistent dry-run exit-management preview with live writes blocked, bounded polling, state checks, release verification, and explicit limits on what the public build can do.
